headline: Public comment on four rent increase applications, including 638 Congress St and three Grant St buildings.
summary: Four rent increase applications will get public comment, including one covering all 101 units at 638 Congress St. Other items include approving findings of fact, rescheduling the regular December meeting, and an annual report update.
items: Approval of findings of fact and conclusions of law
Public comment on rent increase application for 91 State St, all 10 units
Public comment on rent increase application for 340 Eastern Promenade #213, owned by Julie and Daniel Sullivan
Public comment on rent increase application for 638 Congress St, all 101 units, for increased housing service costs
Public comment on rent increase application for 125, 129, and 133 Grant St, for increased housing service costs
